## 4. Strategy & Pool Execution Analysis

- **All-Time Strategy Breakdown:** Performance comparison across strategies (`bid_ask` vs `spot`).
- **Organic Score Bucket Correlations:** Impact of organic score (75-100, 50-75, 25-50, 0-25) on fee yield and win rate.
- **Volatility Bucket Correlations:** Impact of volatility (Medium 3-6, High 6-10, Extreme >10, Low <3) on PnL and out-of-range frequency.
- **Screener Refusal Analysis:** Breakdown of candidate pool rejection reasons from `decision-log.json`.
